beschreibung: A new spec caches one page in a module-level variable and hands it to both of its tests. Under fullyParallel the two tests sometimes land in the same worker, where the second one inherits the cart the first one filled, and sometimes in two workers, where each gets its own page.
begruendung: test-only change: the new spec caches one page per worker process and shares it between two tests, so whether the second test sees the first test's cart depends on how the workers happen to pick the tests up
